title: The Disappearance of the USS Cyclops
description: In March 1918, the U.S. Navy collier USS Cyclops disappeared in the Atlantic with 306 people aboard. It sent no distress call, and neither the ship nor its crew was found.

scenes.narration: In March 1918, a massive U.S. Navy cargo ship sailed from Barbados toward Baltimore.
